candidates.tagline: McDonald's recycled Happy Meal toys into a computer mouse — 4,000 units, China only, sold out in minutes
candidates.story: On October 22–23, 2026, McDonald's China and Lenovo launched the 'Fry Mark,' a wireless computer mouse shaped like a McDonald's french-fries carton and made from over 60% recycled Happy Meal toy plastic; just 4,000 units were available exclusively through the McDonald's app and WeChat for ¥99 + 18 member points, and they sold out almost instantly.
candidates.why_funny: McDonald's framed this as a sustainability initiative to rescue plastic Happy Meal toys from landfills, then channelled them into a luxury collectible computer peripheral that fewer than 4,000 China McDonald's power users can own.
candidates.alt: A red wireless computer mouse shaped exactly like a McDonald's french-fries carton, with golden fries emerging from the top and the McDonald's Golden Arches logo on the side, displayed on a flat surface

candidates.tagline: Apple called the OLED iPad mini its 'biggest upgrade ever' — it still tops out at the same 60Hz as your 2021 model
candidates.story: On October 26, 2026, Apple announced the first-ever OLED iPad mini, marketing it as the 'biggest update ever' for the product; the 8.5-inch OLED panel is genuinely new, but Apple kept the screen locked at 60Hz — the same refresh rate as the 2021 LCD model — while every OLED iPad Pro ships with ProMotion 120Hz, a feature iPad mini users have asked for since 2021.
candidates.why_funny: Apple spent the engineering budget to make the iPad mini's blacks blacker and its colors more vivid with OLED — and then didn't bother adding the feature that would have made it feel smoother to use, keeping that strictly for the model that costs twice as much.
candidates.alt: Apple iPad mini 7 tablet photographed from the front showing its compact 8.3-inch display and slim aluminum chassis — nearly identical in form factor to the 2026 OLED model Apple marketed as its 'biggest iPad mini upgrade ever' while keeping the same 60Hz screen rate
